grammar.title: 動詞 + 完：to finish doing something
grammar.explanation: 完 goes right after the verb to show the action is completed or finished. Add 了 at the end for a completed action, and use 沒 or 還沒 for the negative (drop 了).

examples.pinyin: Wǒ hē wán chá jiù huí jiā.
examples.gloss: I'll go home as soon as I finish my tea.

grammar.title: 時間長度：Verb + 了 + Number + 個小時
grammar.pattern: Subject + Verb + 了 + 數字 + 個小時
grammar.explanation: To say how long an action lasted, put the time length after the verb. 小時 is the word for "hour" and needs the measure word 個.

examples.hanzi: 我們走了一個小時的路。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zǒu le yí ge xiǎoshí de lù.
Tā shuì le jiǔ ge xiǎoshí.

examples.hanzi: 我在那裡玩了三個小時。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài nàlǐ wán le sān ge xiǎoshí.
examples.gloss: I had fun there for three hours.

grammar.title: 正在 + 動詞 (in the middle of doing something)
grammar.pattern: 主語 + 正在 + 動詞 + (名詞)
grammar.explanation: Use 正在 before a verb to say the action is happening right now. It often goes with 呢 at the end of the sentence: 他正在看書呢。To say it is not happening now, just answer with 沒有 or say 我沒有在看書。

examples.pinyin: tā zhèngzài mén wài dǎ diànhuà.
examples.gloss: He is making a phone call outside the door.

examples.hanzi: 我姐姐正在穿新衣服呢。
examples.pinyin: wǒ jiějie zhèngzài chuān xīn yīfú ne.
examples.gloss: My older sister is putting on new clothes.

examples.hanzi: 老師正在幫助那個學生。
examples.gloss: The teacher is helping that student.

grammar.title: 看得懂 / 看不懂 (can or cannot understand by reading)
grammar.explanation: Put 得 or 不 between the verb 看 and 懂 to say whether you can understand something by looking at it. 看得懂 = can understand (when reading); 看不懂 = cannot understand. For a question, use 嗎 or the A-not-A form 看得懂看不懂.

examples.pinyin: Zhè ge hàn zì wǒ kàn bù dǒng.
examples.gloss: I can't read this Chinese character.
